ios.desc:
Reams is a serious, joyful and open app for readers. It works with newsletters, RSS and articles that you save manually from the web. 

Reams brings each one of your articles to life with an eye-popping, AI driven, algorithmic layout engine. Add delightful interactions and thoughtful features, and you get an app that lets you focus on the immersive pleasures of text and image.

Terms: http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

• BEAUTIFUL LAYOUTS: Reams uses finely wrought algorithms and a sprinkling of AI to turn your articles into an immersive magazine: every story has a unique layout.
• STAY SYNCHRONIZED: Automatic sync between your devices, plus a browser-based UI coming very soon.
• STAY ORGANIZED: tags, notes and highlights mean you never lose track of things.
• REMEMBER WHAT YOU'VE READ: every article looks different, so they stay in your memory.
• PAINLESS NEWSLETTERS: use your reams.app email address and get newsletters out of your inbox and into the perfect reading environment.
• SIMPLE RSS DISCOVERY: Reams scours websites for feeds and lets you easily subscribe to them.
• FULL TEXT VIEW: Load the full text for any story, even if the feed only shows you an extract.
• AUTOMATIC DARK MODE: So that you can read at night without burning your retinas.
• And so much else besides…
